window-1.title: Artcontext
window-1.blurb: It's one artist's decades-deep warren of collaborative browser drawing tools and net experiments, and you can actually leave your own marks inside it — old-web, zero polish, exactly your kind of rabbit hole.

window-2.title: Dirt
window-2.blurb: A rotating cast of sharp writers taking internet ephemera, movies and fandom as seriously as you do — it's the newsletter that'll hand you three references before breakfast and leave you itching to remix them.

window-3.title: Golden Hour Chrysanthemum Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It takes the dried chrysanthemum flowers sitting in your grandma's tea tin and shakes them into something golden and bar-worthy with maple and lemon — heritage drink, full persona change.

window-4.title: Inside a Maximalist Home Filled with Art, Antiques & Community
window-4.blurb: It's a house where nothing matches and everything has a story behind it, narrated by the person who dragged each piece home — exactly the kind of warm, overstuffed, friend-filled room you'd want to build and then throw a party in.

window-5.title: Soft Order, Bukit Merah
window-5.blurb: A barely-opened Bukit Merah cafe with Seoul-cool bones, an in-house bakery and drinks too pretty to drink — go now while it still feels like your discovery, and bring the film camera.
